description: Compute the date N working days after (or before, if N is negative) a start date for a UAE emirate/sector, skipping weekends and public holidays, and list every skipped day with its reason. Use for SLAs, delivery promises, HR processing times and 'within X business days' wording. Example: {start_date:'2026-05-21', days:3, emirate:'federal', sector:'public'} → end_date 2026-06-02 (Eid Al Adha week skipped). Response always includes data_confidence ('high' = all dates officially announced/confirmed, 'medium' = something is estimated), estimated_items[], sources[] (official URLs) and data_version.

count_start_day.description: If true and start_date is a working day, it counts as day 1. Default false (start the day after).
count_start_day.title: Count Start Day

days.description: Working days to add. Negative counts backwards.
days.title: Days

emirate.description: Calendar profile emirate: federal | abu_dhabi | dubai | sharjah | ajman | umm_al_quwain | ras_al_khaimah | fujairah. Use 'federal' unless the user named an emirate's government. Emirates other than Sharjah currently follow the federal weekend.
emirate.title: Emirate

sector.description: Sector: public (government) | private. Government employees, courts and ministries → 'public'. Companies → 'private' (weekend is employer-set; the common Sat–Sun default is used and flagged).
sector.title: Sector

name: add_working_days
title: Add or subtract UAE working days
